shells.base: Rasi mobile PWA on a 390px phone, light theme only, IBM Plex Sans (IBM Plex Mono for codes like CUS-00412, ACC-2026-0091, LN-07). Mint canvas background #F5FBFA; white cards and rows with 12px corners and a 1px hairline #DAE6E5; one accent, Rasi Teal #007370, for primary buttons, links, the active tab and focus. Text Deep Slate #14242B, secondary #45565B. 16px side padding, one column, 48px controls, 16px body text, tabular figures. Money in Indian format with the rupee sign, e.g. ₹1,23,456.50. Status badges are small 6px-rounded rectangles with a dot: green #36692A on #E4F9DA, amber #875315 on #FFF2D2, coral #AB3B2D on #FFEDEA, violet #694B96 on #F4EEFF (violet is status only). Phosphor regular icons. Indian names and shops only. No floating action button, no hamburger menu, no gradients, no glows, no emoji, no dark mode.
shells.console: Top app bar 56px, white, bottom hairline: at a tab's root the brand mark (small teal rounded square with a white 'R') at left then the area name; on pushed screens a back arrow instead. At right a bell icon with a small coral count '3' and at most one contextual icon button. Bottom tab bar 64px plus safe area, white, top hairline, five items each a Phosphor icon over a 12px label; the active item sits in a 64x32 teal-wash pill (#DBF7F3) with a filled teal icon and teal label, the rest in muted slate.

shells.junior: Junior field app, used one-handed outdoors and often offline. No tab bar, no drawer, no menu. A fixed 40px status strip under the safe area on every screen: at left a green dot and 'Online' (or amber dot and 'Offline'), in the middle a small amber chip '2 not sent' when entries are queued, at right a bell icon. Every tap target at least 44px, primary buttons 52px, body 16px, amounts 20 to 24px semibold tabular. Other screens show a ghost '← Route' button at top left. Never show invested amount, profit, or any other line.
shells.none: No app bar and no tab bar. Mint canvas, content in a single column with 24px side padding, starting a quarter of the way down the screen.
